Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pre-audit risk alignment & evidence triage — initial asks

Hi Priyom / Mina,

We have the external scope confirmation call with Zeta next week and Acme's internal security team asked for a short sampling plan up front. I put together a quick triage ask so we can limit the initial evidence upload to what auditors will want for the pre-audit review. Can you both take ownership of the bolded items and respond with owners + artifact locations by EOD Monday? High-level asks below: 

- Scope: ISO 27001 controls mapped to SOC 2/SIG/C A I Q overlaps (see attached control-matrix_v2.xlsx). Highlight which controls will be sampled for the audit window (we are targeting 4 months of evidence).
- FedRAMP readiness: provide an inventory of FedRAMP-relevant config snapshots, IAM role docs, and retention policy excerpts (scope-summary-fedramp.pdf attached).
- SIG/CAIQ: pick 10 questionnaire items that will likely require tech-level artifacts (network diagrams, encryption key custody, event logs). Prepare a small sample ZIP (sig-caiq-sample-pack.zip) with representative artifacts.
- Timeline: need artifacts uploaded to the Drive folder and a short owner table by 2026-11-02 17:00 PST.

I've attached a first-pass control mapping. If any of these items are noisy to collect (e.g., requires infra team churn), flag it and we can include a short note for the auditors explaining alternate evidence.

Thanks — I know this is tight but it's critical for the pre-audit kickoff.

Dylan Brooks
Manager, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
